verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes a Directory of services that agents can access programmatically. Its MCP server also exposes a documented find-sellers tool, so agents can discover payable sellers themselves. Seller services are listed with pricing and identity requirements after Skyfire approval. Missing for 10: documentation of the directory's search/filter schema and the find-sellers tool's output format, a public machine-readable discovery index outside MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration that discovery works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index
